title: Quick Pasta Rosa
subtitle: with a creamy tomato sauce and parmesan
description: Penne in a pink sauce of crushed tomatoes and cream, finished with plenty of parmesan. Ready in 30 minutes.

steps.text: Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large pot and gently cook the crushed garlic until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cream and cook for 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add the basil leaves. Simmer on low heat for another 10 minutes.
Cook the penne according to the packet instructions. Reserve half a cup of the pasta water.
Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce with the reserved pasta water. Cook on high heat for 2 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and serve immediately with plenty more parmesan on top.
